moments.title: The Hundred Tournament Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred men's and women's cricket tournaments are in full swing across England and Wales, with daily matches leading up to the finals on August 16th at Lord's.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Cricket fever is still gripping the nation! The Hundred is delivering thrilling action daily as teams battle for a spot in the August 16th finals. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire
angles.copy: Our Welsh Fire teams are still fighting hard in The Hundred! Catch the latest from the Sophia Gardens side as the tournament heats up towards the finals. #WelshFire

angles.name: Southern Brave
angles.copy: Southern Brave continue their campaign in The Hundred! Keep an eye on the local heroes from the South Coast as they push for glory in the 100-ball tournament. #SouthernBrave

moments.title: Premier League Season Kick-Off Nears
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are deep into pre-season training, with the Community Shield between Arsenal and Manchester City set for August 16th in Cardiff, ahead of the league start on August 21st.

angles.name: Community Shield Countdown
angles.copy: The 2026/27 football season is almost here! The Community Shield kicks things off on August 16th as Arsenal face Manchester City. Who's ready?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up to host the Community Shield on August 16th! A huge pre-season showcase for the capital. Are you heading to Principality Stadium?

angles.name: Pre-Season Buzz
angles.copy: Pre-season friendlies are wrapping up and the Premier League is just around the corner! What are your predictions for the new season?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Yungblud!
moments.blurb: Doncaster-born rock sensation Yungblud, known for his energetic anthems, celebrates his 29th birthday today, August 5th.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Sending massive birthday wishes to the one and only Yungblud, who turns 29 today! What's your favourite track from the rock star?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: 29 years young for the brilliant Yungblud! Let's blast some of his biggest rock anthems to celebrate his birthday.

moments.title: Houghton Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Houghton Festival, a celebration of electronic music and arts curated by DJ Craig Richards, continues in Norfolk until August 9th.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Houghton Festival is still buzzing in Norfolk! Who's soaking up the incredible electronic music and art this weekend?

angles.name: UK Festival
angles.copy: One of the UK's most anticipated electronic music festivals, Houghton, is in full swing! Wishing everyone a great time if you're there.

moments.title: The Roots Picnic UK Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl in London this weekend, August 8th-9th.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London! The legendary Roots Picnic lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend for its first ever UK edition. Get ready for some incredible hip-hop and culture!

angles.name: Hip-Hop History
angles.copy: A huge weekend for music as The Roots Picnic brings its unique vibe to the UK for the very first time. Expect an unforgettable blend of music and culture!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson!

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Raise your horns! Bruce Dickinson, the legendary voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 this Friday. What's your all-time favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson! The 80s wouldn't have been the same without his incredible vocals.

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: It's Shawn Mendes' birthday this weekend! Get ready to celebrate with some of his biggest hits on Nation.

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Edge!

angles.name: Guitar Legend

angles.name: U2 Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating The Edge's 65th birthday this Saturday! From 'With Or Without You' to 'Beautiful Day', his guitar work is unmistakable.

angles.name: 70s Icon

moments.title: Happy Birthday Neneh Cherry!
